mapper.sql: select a.assignment_id,a.student_id,su.nick_name student_name,a.workstation_id,w.room_id,r.room_name,w.workstation_no, w.workstation_type,a.application_id,a.term_code,a.started_at,a.ended_at,a.operator_id from gw_assignment a join gw_workstation w on w.workstation_id=a.workstation_id left join gw_room r on r.room_id=w.room_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id=a.student_id
mapper.select: and a.student_id=#{studentId} and exists(select 1 from gw_user_profile p where p.user_id=a.student_id and p.mentor_id=#{mentorId}) and a.ended_at is null order by a.assignment_id desc
where a.student_id=#{studentId} and a.ended_at is null limit 1
mapper.update: update gw_assignment set ended_at=now(),operator_id=#{operatorId} where assignment_id=#{assignmentId} and ended_at is null
